evidence.quote: Both the lattice mismatches of BCC/Nb2C and BCC/NbC phases lay in the range of 5~25%, indicating a semi-coherent interface between the BCC and carbide phases
A high density of dislocations with a wavy character are detected in the deformed BCC phase while the Nb2C and NbC carbides remain low KAM with almost no dislocations
A high density of dislocations with a wavy character are detected in the deformed BCC phase while the Nb2C and NbC carbides remain low KAM with almost no dislocations
The C0.25 alloy exhibits a high yield strength of 1.27 GPa
a compressive strength of 2.03 GPa
the highest fracture strain of 17.8% among Nb2Mo0.5W0.5Cx alloys
Solid solution strengthening from alloying elements and second phase strengthening from carbide phases contribute to the high strengths
Solid solution strengthening from alloying elements and second phase strengthening from carbide phases contribute to the high strengths
the plasticity is improved mainly from fine grain strengthening and strong bonding of phase interface by reducing the interfacial energy and slowing down the crack propagation

The soft BCC phase blunts crack tips and slow down crack propagation by relieving high local stresses (Fig. 7). This good combination together slows down the crack propagation and results in excellent strength and plasticity of the C0.25 alloy.
